changes.from:
oqto-sandbox NetworkMode::Proxy puts agents in a network namespace that DNATs all TCP to eavs <host>:<tcp_port> and DNS to <host>:<dns_port> (oqto-h6hr). eavs must answer both:

1. Transparent TCP proxy: accept DNAT'd connections, recover original dst via getsockopt SO_ORIGINAL_DST, peek the first bytes to extract hostname (TLS ClientHello SNI / HTTP Host header), enforce existing network_acl::check_host_allowed (domain allow/deny + private-IP SSRF block), then splice bytes to the real dst (transparent passthrough, no MITM). Deny = close.
2. DNS relay: UDP listener forwarding queries to a configurable upstream resolver and relaying responses (no parsing needed for v1; enforcement is at the TCP/SNI layer).
3. Config: [transparent] section (enabled, listen host/port, dns port, upstream resolver); wire both listeners into run_server alongside the HTTP listener.

Reuses network_acl.rs (check_host_allowed) directly. NO secret injection in this increment -- MITM + credential injection is the separate eavs-sth0 (secret-aware proxying). This increment makes proxy-mode egress functional end-to-end: agent reaches allowlisted domains, everything else blocked, all egress forced through eavs.
changes.to:
DESIGN (Option C, chosen): the destination is conveyed to eavs via the PROXY protocol (v2), prepended by a tiny per-session shim that runs INSIDE the agent netns (oqto-sandbox side, separate work). SO_ORIGINAL_DST works inside the agent netns where the DNAT happened; the shim recovers exact orig dst IP+port and relays to eavs with a PROXY v2 header. This keeps part-1's per-netns DNAT topology (no host-global netfilter) and full dst fidelity.

eavs side (THIS issue): a transparent TCP listener that
1. parses the PROXY v2 header -> exact original dst IP:port (where to connect)
2. peeks TLS ClientHello SNI / HTTP Host -> hostname (for the domain ACL)
3. applies network_acl::check_host_allowed(hostname); posture is enforce (proxy: deny on fail/no-hostname) or monitor (log-only, allow all)
4. connects orig dst, splices bytes (passthrough; MITM/secret-injection is the separate eavs-sth0)
Config: [transparent] enabled, listen host/port, enforce flag. Wire into run_server alongside the HTTP + DNS listeners. DNS relay + the oqto-side shim are tracked separately.

note: eavs side complete: transparent PROXY-v2 TCP listener (SNI/Host ACL, enforce/monitor posture, exact-dst splice) + DNS relay, both behind [transparent] config, spawned in run_server. 9 module tests, full suite 343+ green. Remaining end-to-end work is the oqto-sandbox in-namespace shim + DNAT re-point (separate repo, tracked under oqto-h6hr follow-up). MITM/credential injection remains eavs-sth0.
